import.title: Import
import.heading: Import a CuraManager library
import.intro: Zip your CuraManager library folder and drop it here. Every project folder inside becomes a project, and each metadata.json contributes its tags, source URL and archived flag.

viewer.title: Model viewer
viewer.canvasLabel: 3D view of the model. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. With the view focused, the arrow keys rotate, + and - zoom, and 0 resets it.
viewer.noWebgl: This browser could not open a 3D view. WebGL may be switched off, or too many 3D views are already open -- reload the page and try again.
viewer.unsupported: This viewer shows {{ formats }} models, and cannot open a {{ extension }} file. Download it from the project page to open it in your slicer.
viewer.missingFile: This file is not part of this project any more. Go back to the project to see what it holds now.
viewer.fetchFailed: The model could not be downloaded. Check your connection, then reload the page to try again.
viewer.parseFailed: This file could not be read as a {{ extension }} model. It may be damaged or only partly uploaded -- try uploading it again.
viewer.emptyModel: This model contains no triangles, so there is nothing to show. The file may have been exported empty.
viewer.slicerProject: This is a slicer project rather than a plain model, so there is no single mesh here to show. Download it from the project page to open it in your slicer.
viewer.tooLarge: This model is {{ size }}. Opening a {{ extension }} file can take many times its own size in memory, and there is no way to tell how much this one needs without downloading it first -- so the viewer asks instead, and nothing has been downloaded yet.
